ios.desc:
Montir is a must-have app for anyone who enjoys movies, TV, or anime of any kind!

Keep track of watched content by keeping a master list, ranked on a scale from 0.0 to 10.0. Instead of guessing at star ratings, Montir asks a simple question — "which did you like more?" — and turns your head-to-head picks into precise scores.

Connect with friends to see what they're watching, plus a compatibility score based on mutual ratings — or find others who share your taste.

Build a watchlist with recommendations from your friends, and see the sentiment from people whose opinion you actually care about.

Additional features like a uniqueness score measuring how hot your takes are, leaving notes and tagging others, and many more can be found inside of Montir — your one-stop shop for all things cinema.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Rank movies, TV, and anime with quick "this or that" comparisons that build 0.0–10.0 scores
• Keep one master list of everything you've watched, always in order
• Add friends and see a taste-compatibility score from your mutual ratings
• Find people with similar taste across the community
• Build a watchlist powered by your friends' recommendations
• Check your uniqueness score to see how hot (or basic) your takes really are
• Leave notes, tag friends, and climb the leaderboard
• Find friends already on Montir from your contacts (optional, privacy-first)

PRIVACY-FIRST BY DESIGN
• Sign in with just your phone number — no passwords
• Contact matching is optional and hashes numbers on your device; we never see your contacts' names or raw numbers
• No ads, no cross-app tracking, and we never sell your data
• Delete your account and data anytime from Profile → Account

Montir — your one-stop shop for all things cinema.
